summary: Bien Doan, a sitting San Jose District 7 City Council member, was part of a unanimous January 2024 council statement calling for a ceasefire in Gaza, humanitarian aid, and hostage release held by both Hamas and Israel. The action condemns ongoing humanitarian harm while its bilateral hostage framing and unanimous nature do not establish a more specific individual position on Israeli war crimes, West Bank settlement violence, or US military aid to Israel.
